headline: MISSED CATCH-UP (UKMTO/JMIC advisory Oct 25, in no prior scan) -- Hormuz shipping 'severely disrupted'
dek: UKMTO (via Shafaq, Oct 25): shipping through the Strait of Hormuz 'remains severely disrupted' after the US-Israeli war on Iran; 101 vessels transited Hormuz between Oct 22 and 24, against an average of about 138 vessels per day in 2025. Bab el-Mandeb recorded 58 crossings over the same 72 hours,…
sources: UKMTO / Joint Maritime Information Centre (JMIC) Advisory Note, Oct 25, via Shafaq News
fault_line: Open or blockaded: is Hormuz 'open' because CENTCOM escorts thousands of vessels, or 'severely disrupted' because daily transits run at roughly a quarter of the 2025 average -- and whose count do you trust?
